resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and the Forest Fire Lookout Association list share register number US 1961 but give coordinates about 5.7 km apart; firelookout.com's 'two miles west of summit' does not settle which is right. Left unresolved in the story.

sources.title: Haystack Ridge Lookout Site, trip report

notes_for_editor: Location conflict: register coordinates 47.809462, -121.751159 vs Forest Fire Lookout Association list 47.82333, -121.67731, about 5.7 km apart; the record's conflict note 'They share a register number' is correct (both cite US 1961). Agency conflict: the register says U.S. Forest Service; the 2022 WTA report describes private timberland under a Forest Legacy easement; the record has ownership 'federal'. The story says so and tells visitors to check. The WTA 'Haystack Ridge Lookout Site' is matched to this register entry by name and locality (near Sultan); the register itself does not name Sultan, so this is likely but not confirmed; the story now hedges it as 'appears to be this one'. height_m 12.2 is the register's 40 feet converted. The abandonment year is not given by any source, so no abandoned event was written. Access level 'restricted' rests on one trip report; verify with the landowner or DNR before publishing access advice. No new photos found.
